Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for running the trial with our dedicated profile last week. We captured a few throughput/latency profiles and would like to run a short readout + Q&A with your infra and security teams to go over the numbers, validation approach, and next steps for production rollout.

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Wed Jun 16: 13:00–14:00 ET (30–40 minute readout + time for questions)
- Fri Jun 18: 11:00–12:00 ET (alternate)

Attendees we suggest: AE (me), SE (Diego), your infra lead (Elaine), FastRetail security rep, and procurement (for contract/timing). If you prefer two shorter sessions (pre-call with Redwood security/SE then customer-facing readout), we can do that too.

Agenda (high level):
- 5 min intro & success criteria
- 20 min benchmark walkthrough (throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency, tails)
- 10 min configuration & reproductions (model config, batching, quantization)
- 10 min open questions & next actions

Attached: benchmark-exec-summary.pdf (executive summary). Full data files will be available in the shared folder after we lock timing.

Please confirm availability or suggest times. Also let us know if your security team needs any pre-reads (SOC 2, data handling notes) so we can prepare.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
